name: Khazarad Inn
desc1: This large, homey inn is well-appointed and warmly heated by a massive
desc2: fireplace in the northern wall. A few tables and pairs of chairs sit
desc3: in one corner of the room, while a counter is set here for whoever
desc4: keeps the inn. The inn's only exit is to the south, while a corridor
desc5: leads to the stairwell to the east.
